title: Company

help.title: About your company
help.overview: Your business's details, as customers see them on your website and on the portal. Use Edit to change them.

sections.title: Details
items: Only the name is required. Add your NIPT/VAT number to get the Verified badge on the portal.
Email, phone, website, social links, description and logo are optional, but they make your listing more complete.
Each address needs the street, postal code, city, country and a map pin; the state or canton is optional.

sections.title: Website chat
items: Turn the assistant bot on or off and set its greeting and tone.
Choose whether visitors must say who they are and whether they can ask for a person. Those conversations arrive under Website chats.

sections.title: Company status
items: A company that belongs to a parent company can be switched off and on again here.
